about_the_game:
Death Relives – Original Soundtrack
Composed by Can Bora Tanzer

Step into the shadowy depths of the Aztec underworld and experience the raw power of Death Relives through its fully orchestrated, atmospheric soundtrack. Renowned composer Can Bora Tanzer blends tribal percussion, ethereal vocals, and dark orchestral swells to evoke the terror, mystery, and poignant beauty of a world caught between life and death. From the sweeping grandeur of the Main Theme to the ritualistic pulse of “Xipe Totec,” each piece carries you deeper into the game’s haunting narrative.
